Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. About the Role We are seeking a
proactive and highly organized Administration Specialist (m/f/d) to
join our HQ office. In this role, you will be responsible for
coordinating a wide range of administrative, operational, and
organizational activities that contribute to the efficient running of
the office and support a positive employee and visitor experience. The
ideal candidate is detail-oriented, service-focused, and enjoys
managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. You will work
closely with internal stakeholders, external partners, and leadership
teams to ensure seamless administrative processes and excellent
operational support. Your Responsibilities Office Management &
Administration Manage the day-to-day administrative operations of the
HQ office Ensure the office environment is well-maintained, organized,
and fully operational Coordinate office supplies, equipment, and
vendor relationships Prepare and manage correspondence, letters, and
official documentation Maintain records, administrative files, and
internal databases Support document management and filing processes
Meeting & Event Coordination Organize and coordinate internal
meetings, workshops, training sessions, and company events Manage
meeting schedules, invitations, agendas, and logistics Prepare meeting
rooms, materials, and presentations as required Coordinate catering,
external service providers, and event-related vendors Support the
successful execution of employee engagement activities and corporate
events Travel & Logistics Management Coordinate domestic and
international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation,
transportation, and itineraries Support visitors and business guests
with travel and logistical arrangements Ensure travel documentation
and administrative requirements are completed on time Assist with
travel expense administration and reporting processes Administrative &
Operational Support Provide administrative support to management and
cross-functional teams Coordinate incoming and outgoing correspondence
and deliveries Support procurement and purchase order administration
Assist with invoice processing and vendor-related documentation
Contribute to the development and improvement of administrative
processes and procedures Stakeholder & Visitor Management Serve as a
point of contact for office-related inquiries Welcome and support
visitors, partners, and external stakeholders Coordinate
onboarding-related administrative activities for new employees when
required Foster a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented office
environment What You Bring Completed vocational training or degree in
Business Administration, Office Management, Hospitality Management, or
a related field Several years of experience in administration, office
management, executive support, or a similar role Excellent
organizational and coordination skills with strong attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high-quality
standards Strong communication and interpersonal skills Proactive,
reliable, and solution-oriented approach Proficiency in Microsoft
Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Experience
working with administrative and procurement processes is an advantage
Fluency in German and English What We Offer A diverse and impactful
role at our HQ office An international and collaborative working
environment Opportunities to contribute to office operations, employee
experience, and organizational effectiveness Professional development
and learning opportunities Flexible and modern workplace environment A
supportive team culture that values initiative, collaboration, and
continuous improvement Application Process Overview The position will
stay open until a successful candidate is chosen. Application Review:
Our team thoroughly reviews each application. Please make sure to
submit your CV in English. Initial Interview (30 minutes): Meet with
the hiring manager and HR team. Second Interview (60 minutes): Second
interview with a presentation on a relevant topic to the hiring
manager and the HR team. Offer: If successful, receive an offer to
join our team.

all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of

decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Junior Project Leader (f-m-d) Engineering -
Milwaukee® Key Responsibilities: Lead and develop NPD projects in
EMEA in accordance with our development process on all technical
aspects for design and development Coordinate technical aspects in the
NPD Project for Professional Products EMEA or ROW driven Check
NPQ/PEAC/CTQs and coordinate results between Product Management,
Quality, Regulatory, Reliability and After Sales and prepare for EMEA
sign-off to provide a technical specification meeting to the customer
expectation Participate in the 2D/3D design reviews with Product
Management and Engineering Work closely with external partners and
vendors within the New Development Project Coordinate the Sample
Inspection Report with Product Management (EMEA), Engineering and
Quality teams (PRC) to support the pilot run approval and the
subsequent release for mass production Determine with team on
temporary deviation and releases Make technical file available for TTI
EMEA on product level and check integrity of the technical file Assess
and sign off temporary deviation for engineering if necessary, during
mass production Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
technical education, preferably in mechanical or engineering or a
related field Ideally experience in project management and product
development Good understanding of technical processes in engineering
like product development, technical documentation Ideally experienced
in Personal Protective Equipment or Power Tools business Excellent
command of German and English, both written and spoken, another
European language is of advantage Extensive experience with MS Office
application Knowledge in CAD system Willingness to travel according to
business need (20% approx.) Your perks: An interesting position with
an attractive company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu

Randstad is one of the world's leading talent companies with the
ambition to be the world's most equitable and specialized talent
company. Through our "partner for talent" corporate strategy, we find,
develop and connect specialized talents with companies - worldwide,
locally and always at a high speed. We build high-quality, diverse,
and agile teams, while individuals can enjoy a rewarding career path
with equitable opportunities.

Randstad Professional is one of Randstad's four specializations
and focuses on the placement of specialists and managers in the
future-oriented sectors of IT, Engineering, Life Science and Office.

Our mission: We bring people together! We are currently offering an
attractive position as CTSU trial manager with one of our customers

- a pharmaceutical company in Biberach. A fair compensation and
personal support are of course included. You have a master's
degree in natural science? Then you are a perfect match for us – we
look forward to hearing from you! Apply online now! We welcome
applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of any
disabilities.
- Responsible for global Supply Chain activities for Investigational
Medicinal Products (IMPs) of national and international Phase I-IV
clinical trials in the Therapeutic Area General Medicine
- Function as the main point of contact to Clinical Operations and
Clinical Development for assigned trials, ensuring the timely and cost
efficient provision of clinical supplies
- Act as the responsible leader of the CTSU trial team within the
matrix structure, ensuring cross-functional collaboration and
development of interfaces for all Supply Chain activities on the basis
of business, regulatory and industry needs
- Provide input to clinical trial protocols and bulk demands incl.
comparator and non-IMP commercial products, to specific packaging
designs and efficient distribution strategies
- Support investigations as Subject Matter Expert for assigned trials
- Master's degree in natural sciences or similar disciplines or
completed vocational training with experience in clinical trials
- Several years experiences in clinical trial supplies or related
business
- Experience in working in an international environment, as well as
team leading and project management experiences
- Ideally good knowledge and understanding of the regulatory and
GMP/GCP requirements for IMPs
- Ability to interpret complex project requirements
- Good software skills (MS Office)
- Fluent English and good German skills, both spoken and written
- Strong problem solving capabilities with the willingness to make
decisions and the ability to drive results
- Very good communication, negotiation and presentation skills
- Ability to work independently as well as in a team
- Performance-based salary package depending on qualifications and
professional experience
- Extensive social benefits, incl. Christmas and holiday bonuses
- Company pension scheme contribution after the end of the
probationary period
- Up to 30 days vacation per year
- Option of permanent employment with our business partner
- A wide range of employee benefits/perks

Job Description EuroChem is one of the leading manufacturers of
fertilizers, with a long-standing presence in Europe and many
countries overseas. With our broad product portfolio, we offer plant
nutrition solutions for every application, including field
fertilization, fertigation, and foliar fertilization. The Supply &
Operations Planning Manager is a central integrator between the
production site and the regional and local Sales organizations. As
part of the regional team in Mannheim, you take full responsibility
for demand planning, supply balancing, and commercial scenario
development for a defined product group and/or a specific production
site in Europe. We are looking for a committed and experienced: Supply
& Operations Planning Manager (m/w/d) Your Key Responsibilities in
detail: Lead S&OP Planning for a Defined Product Portfolio or
Production Site Own the end-to-end S&OP planning cycle for your
assigned products/sites, ensuring a robust, transparent and efficient
planning process while balancing the interdependencies of continuous
fertilizer production, customer service, production stability,
logistics constraints, working capital and financial performance
Integrate commercial priorities into the planning process by
evaluating business opportunities, optimizing contribution margins,
prioritizing markets and ensuring the optimal deployment of
constrained production capacities Facilitate commercial
decision-making in close collaboration with the Commercial Lead
(responsible for the production site or the European commercial
organization) Commercial & Operational Planning Validate demand
forecasts, evaluate commercial opportunities, identify supply gaps or
surpluses and align production capabilities with Sales Managers and
the Commercial Lead Allocation & prioritization: Define & adjust
product allocations and market priorities (planned product volume/
price-positions) in close collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain
Execution to establish delivery commitments and operational priorities
Support working capital optimization by incorporating Order-to-Cash
(OTC) cycle-time considerations into planning decisions using sales
input and historical performance data Inventory, Production & Shipment
Monitoring Tracking regional inventory targets to balance service
levels, production stability and capital efficiency Monitor the
Production–Shipment Plan (actual vs. planned performance), identify
deviations early and initiate necessary corrective actions, such as
accelerated delivery or reallocation of volumes Your Qualification:
Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial
Engineering or comparable field 2 to 5 years professional work
experience in Supply Chain Planning would be an advantage Strong
analytical and commercial thinking skills; ability to balance
trade-offs and drive decisions Structured, proactive and hands-on
approach in dynamic environments Very good communication and
stakeholder management skills High IT affinity; strong Excel skills;
experience with S&OP planning tools is a plus Fluent English (written
and spoken); additional languages are beneficial Enjoy working in a
collaborative, supportive team culture Kontakt Like to work
independently and on your own responsibility? Entrepreneurial thinking
and acting is a matter of course for you? Then we should get to know
each other! Please send your detailed CV in English to Human
Resources, attention Andreas Wagner Andreas.Wagner@eurochem.group

metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.

sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community

growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,

guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and

professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements

internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR

managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven

initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data

Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing

High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential

Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with

learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,

Regional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH (m/f/d)

Hybrid–Berlin | Cologne | Frankfurt | Hamburg | Hannover | Leipzig | Munich | Nuremberg | StuttgartGo To Market – Sales / Full-time / HybridRegional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH (m/f/d)

Shape the Future of Industrial AI with Mendix and Intelligence Center X
At Mendix, a Siemens business, we are redefining how enterprises build, deploy and scale intelligent applications. As the leading low-code platform, Mendix empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation by combining software development, AI and enterprise collaboration.
With the introduction of Intelligence Center X, Siemens is entering the next generation of Industrial AI. Intelligence Center X combines enterprise data, AI agents, knowledge graphs and intelligent applications into a secure and governed ecosystem that enables organizations to move from isolated AI initiatives to enterprise-wide transformation.
To accelerate this vision across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, we are looking for an experienced Regional Enterprise Sales Director Industrial AI Transformation DACH.
This executive leadership role combines commercial leadership, strategic market development and executive customer engagement. You will be responsible for scaling the Mendix business while establishing Intelligence Center X as the leading Industrial AI platform for enterprise customers across the region.
Your Mission
You will own the commercial strategy, market expansion and business performance for Mendix and Intelligence Center X across DACH.
Working closely with Siemens Digital Industries Software, Siemens Xcelerator, Partner Sales, Customer Success, Product Management and Services, you will build one of Siemens' fastest growing software businesses.
Your Responsibilities:Commercial Leadership

- Define and execute the regional growth strategy for Mendix and Intelligence Center X.- Deliver sustainable Annual Contract Value (ACV), ARR and new-logo growth across the DACH region.- Lead and develop high-performing Sales Directors, Enterprise Account Executives and cross-functional commercial teams.- Build a predictable, data-driven sales organization focused on operational excellence and execution.- Establish executive business reviews, forecasting discipline and performance management frameworks.

Industrial AI Market Development

- Position Intelligence Center X as the strategic Industrial AI platform for enterprise customers.- Help customers evolve from isolated AI pilots toward enterprise-wide AI transformation.- Drive executive conversations around AI, Digital Engineering, Digital Manufacturing, Digital Thread and Enterprise Transformation.- Develop strategic industry plays and AI transformation programs for Manufacturing, Automotive, Energy, Life Sciences, Infrastructure and Process Industries.- Expand Mendix as the preferred platform for intelligent applications, AI copilots and agent-based business processes.

Executive Customer Engagement

- Build trusted relationships with CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers and business executives.- Support strategic enterprise opportunities through executive sponsorship and value-based selling.- Participate directly in key customer engagements and complex negotiations.- Position Siemens as a strategic transformation partner beyond traditional software sales.

Ecosystem Leadership

- Collaborate across Siemens Digital Industries Software, Siemens Xcelerator, AI Studio, Graph Studio and Partner organizations.- Build strong relationships with Global System Integrators, consulting partners and technology alliances.- Develop joint go-to-market initiatives that accelerate Industrial AI adoption.- Represent Mendix and Intelligence Center X at executive events, customer forums and industry conferences.

Intelligence-Driven Business Management

- Leverage customer, market and competitive intelligence to identify growth opportunities.- Build executive dashboards and business insights to improve forecasting, pipeline health and commercial performance.- Translate customer feedback into product innovation together with Product Management.- Establish scalable sales methodologies, industry playbooks and best practices across the region.

Leadership & Culture

- Inspire, coach and develop diverse, high-performing teams.- Foster an inclusive, collaborative and customer-centric culture.- Encourage innovation, continuous learning and experimentation.- Build future sales leaders capable of driving the next generation of Industrial AI transformation.

What You'll Bring:- Extensive executive sales leadership experience within Enterprise Software, SaaS or Industrial Software.- Proven success building and scaling high-growth enterprise businesses across the DACH region.- Strong experience leading second-line sales organizations.- Track record of exceeding revenue targets while developing high-performing commercial teams.- Experience engaging C-level executives on strategic transformation initiatives.- Deep understanding of Digital Transformation, AI, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Platforms or Industrial Software.- Strong analytical capabilities with experience leveraging business intelligence and data-driven decision making.- Experience working within complex matrix organizations and global ecosystems.- Outstanding executive communication, presentation and negotiation skills.- Fluent German and English.

Preferred Experience:- Industrial AI- Low-Code / No-Code Platforms- Enterprise Applications- Manufacturing Digitalization- Siemens Xcelerator Ecosystem- AI Governance- Enterprise Architecture- Platform Business Models- Digital Engineering- Digital Manufacturing- Agentic AI- Knowledge Graphs- Enterprise Data Platforms

What Success Looks Like:Within your first 24 months you will have:

- Significantly accelerated Mendix growth across DACH.- Established Intelligence Center X as a strategic Industrial AI platform within key enterprise accounts.- Built one of the highest-performing enterprise software organizations within Siemens.- Expanded strategic relationships with executive customers and partners.- Created a scalable commercial operating model supporting long-term double-digit growth.- Positioned Mendix as the application platform connecting AI, enterprise data and business processes across the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem.

Why Join Us?
This is more than a regional sales leadership position.
It is an opportunity to shape how Industrial AI is adopted across Europe's largest industrial economy. You will influence executive transformation agendas, build the next generation of enterprise software growth and help define the future of intelligent enterprises together with Siemens and Mendix.
If you are passionate about combining commercial excellence, transformational leadership and Industrial AI innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future.
Our Benefits & Rewards
The total cash compensation range for this position is €174,600 to €349,300 with 40% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
